messages:
amanda: Morning — new hire here (first week). Running Windows 11, PowerShell 7 + WSL2 devcontainer. My PowerShell profile (C:/Users/amanda/Documents/PowerShell/Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1) is injecting a custom prompt and an alias 'll' that seems to leak into the VS Code devcontainer terminal and break our docker-entrypoint scripts. Also my keys are loaded in Pageant and not forwarded into WSL, so git pushes fail with 'Permission denied (publickey)'. Anyone hit this?
kevin: Welcome! Two quick things: 1) If VS Code opens the integrated terminal as PowerShell it will source your profile. Reopen the terminal as 'WSL: Ubuntu' (or Reopen in Container -> then select the WSL distro) so the shell inside the container is the distro's shell. That usually stops host profiles from polluting the container.
amanda: I was launching from VS Code (Reopen in Container) but the terminal defaulted to PowerShell. Switching the terminal to WSL:Ubuntu fixed the prompt/alias issue — thanks.
kevin: 2) For Pageant -> WSL forwarding, we usually recommend 'wsl-ssh-pageant' or npiperelay + socat. Easiest test: install wsl-ssh-pageant on Windows and then in WSL run: 
  eval $(/mnt/c/Users/<user>/wsl-ssh-pageant.exe -l -r)
That hooks the Windows agent into your WSL SSH_AUTH_SOCK.
rachel: We actually have an internal guide with exact steps and a PowerShell snippet to avoid sourcing interactive aliases inside VS Code terminals: https://redwood.internal/devtools/wsl-ssh (VPN only). Example snippet to add to your PowerShell profile:
```
if ($env:TERM -like '*vscode*') { return } # skip interactive aliases in VS Code terminals
```
amanda: Followed the doc, installed wsl-ssh-pageant, switched terminal to WSL, and git push now works. One last thing — how do I request JetBrains license seats?
devon: Ping eng-tools or ping me directly, I can seat you. Also suggest adding a short note to the onboarding checklist so others don't chase this. :+1:
it-support-bot: Created ticket IT-4281 to add 'WSL/PowerShell devcontainer gotchas' to the new-hire checklist.
amanda: Awesome, thanks everyone :party_parrot:
